coverage.name: Moffat County
limitations: Checked 2026-10-10: the elections page now posts 2026 General Election sample ballots labelled City and County (and a Spanish one). Both English PDFs were read. They are image-only scans with no searchable text, so they were read from the rendered page images. No TABOR notice or participating-entities list is posted.

Excluded: Moffat County Ballot Questions 1A, 1B and 1C, which would lengthen the term limits of the Clerk and Recorder, the Assessor and the Treasurer to three consecutive terms (Article XVIII, Section 11). Not housing. These match Resolution 2026-100 (adopted August 25, 2026).

Not county questions and not housing: Moffat County School District RE-1 Ballot Issue 4A (bonded debt) on both styles, and Yampa Valley Regional Transportation Authority Ballot Issue 7A (a sales tax for regional transportation) on the City style.
Commissioners' minutes July 14 to September 8, 2026 show no other county ballot referral.
